newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Consolidate rate cut hopes.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Consolidate rate cut hopes.

text.p: Australian bond spreads showed a slight widening bias on Wednesday as the market waited for direction from local data.

While spreads widened slightly on the day, traders termed the move as consolidative given the significant narrowing in yields that has occurred since the last Reserve Bank of Australia easing on May 23.
Since that easing, spreads have narrowed on expectations of at least one further easing to come from the RBA in the next few months.

However, while another rate cut is widely expected the fact that no major data is scheduled ahead of the next RBA board meeting on July 1 means the market is lacking direction over the next week or so.
The local yield curve was slightly steeper as the short end remained hopeful of another rate cut.
